title: Mouse in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- mouse body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#b0b8c8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#e0e6f0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='18' fill='#b0b8c8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='12' fill='#b0b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='7' fill='#e8a0b8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='12' fill='#b0b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='7' fill='#e8a0b8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='3' fill='#e86a8a'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='36' y1='50' x2='22' y2='47' stroke='#d0d8e8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='53' x2='22' y2='56' stroke='#d0d8e8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='50' x2='78' y2='47' stroke='#d0d8e8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='53' x2='78' y2='56' stroke='#d0d8e8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M32 62 Q50 70 68 62 L68 56 Q50 63 32 56 Z' fill='#e04040'/>
  <path d='M64 62 Q72 66 66 78 L58 76 Q62 68 58 62 Z' fill='#c03030'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='72' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#b0b8c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='72' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#b0b8c8'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#d8a0b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#d8a0b0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 80 Q85 78 82 66 Q80 58 88 56' stroke='#d8a0b0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
